scheme_name: Supply of Prosthetic Appliances to Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native or resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Applicant must have a disability of 40% or above
benefits_summary: Free supply of prosthetic appliances such as calipers, crutches, wheelchairs, tricycles, hearing aids, spectacles, and other low‑vision aids.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (hard copy or printed)
Copies of all mandatory supporting documents (self‑attested)
